payload.question: Your messages no longer go into git. Two other things still do: (1) a copy of each message kept for plumb's first reading of a request (that's your message again), and (2) your answers to plumb's questions, including anything you type in them, like your answers today. Should both stay out of git too, read only from this machine's private log?
